C2 UNVERIFIED for unrestricted active-negative/fallback safety; CLEAN for inspected dependencies/navigation. Each directed edge was assessed independently against actual titles and dictionary senses. N005構→杯 S-intro: Shared 木-left shape only, not explicit. «порция (счётное слово)» does not fit construction, stance, concern or the mulberry entry; no reading identity established. Ordinary safety U.

N010権→集 S-intro: Explicit 隹-like lower-right versus 隹 above 木 contrast. «собирать; собираться» does not fit authority/right, weight, expedient or deputy senses; gathering authority is not lexical identity. Ordinary safety U.
N011権→横 S-intro: Independent intra-batch shape-only comparison, not explicit. «горизонталь; бок» does not fit 権; arbitrary conduct and power are associated, not equivalent. No reading identity established; ordinary safety U.
N012権→校 S-intro: Shared 木-left shape only, not explicit. «школа» does not fit ordinary/additional 権 senses; ケン/ゴン do not equal コウ/キョウ. Ordinary safety U.
N013機→楽 S-intro: Explicit 木-left versus 木-below contrast. «музыка; удовольствие; лёгкость» does not fit 機, including mental-function, trap and aircraft senses. No reading identity established; ordinary safety U.
N014機→校 S-intro: Shared 木-left shape only, not explicit. «школа» does not fit mechanism, opportunity, loom, aircraft or other senses read. No reading identity established; ordinary safety U.

A002 SUPPORTED: 1279680/1279690/1279700/1279730/1279790/1254760 support concern, stance/readiness, construction and nominal 結構; evaluative uses remain separate.

A004 SUPPORTED: 1258080/1258200/1258220/1367200 support rights, authority/influence and human rights. Suffix classification is not presented as frequency evidence.
A005 SUPPORTED: 1220760/1220800/1220810/1485470/2037700 support loom, opportunity, machine and aircraft/counting. Video-game-lives sense is not taught; homophony does not imply history.
